purpose: Completeness audit of quebradas, torrenteras, activatable channels and local systems named in Peruvian public-institution sources, whether or not reproducible GIS geometry exists. duplicate_check.method: Accent-insensitive pattern match of the documentary label, required to co-occur within 500 characters of a district/province token (department token as fallback). duplicate_check.limits: Pattern matching can miss differently spelled records and can over-match common labels; presence statuses are a reviewer aid, not an adjudication.

state_vocabulary.IDENTITY_ONLY: Only identity, critical-point, works or lead-level evidence. No institutional dated event and no geometry lead.
state_vocabulary.GEOMETRY_PENDING: A geometry lead exists (ANA faja-marginal resolution with hitos, or frozen geometry on a non-main branch) but nothing reproducible is in main for this unit.
state_vocabulary.GEOMETRY_REPRODUCIBLE: Reproducible geometry already exists in main for this unit (pre-existing; this audit added none).
state_vocabulary.OUTLET_PENDING: Flag: the unit has a geometry lead or event evidence but no reproducible outlet/confluence node.
state_vocabulary.EVENT_LEAD_UNVERIFIED: At least one dated event statement was read, through automated extraction, in a primary public-institution source, but the source text has not been reopened, verified and archived. It is a lead to verify, not adjudicated evidence, and not an event-ledger entry. List-level attribution is marked as such.
state_vocabulary.EVENT_EVIDENCE: Reserved for rows with at least one EVENT item whose source text is verified: the source carries source_text_verified=true with a verification_record (SHA-256 of the archived file, archive locator, date, verifier) and the item carries source_text_verified=true with its own locator. No row has it in v0.1.
state_vocabulary.MAP_ELIGIBLE: Not assigned by this audit to any row.
state_vocabulary.suggested_state_rule: suggested_state is the single most advanced of GEOMETRY_REPRODUCIBLE > GEOMETRY_PENDING > EVENT_EVIDENCE > EVENT_LEAD_UNVERIFIED > IDENTITY_ONLY; state_flags lists every applicable flag.

evidence_types.CRITICAL_POINT: named in a vulnerability / critical-zone inventory (not an event)
evidence_types.WORKS: named in a works, cleaning or barrier scope (not capacity)
evidence_types.FAJA: ANA faja-marginal resolution (regulatory strip, not footprint, not channel axis)

event_verification_rule.rule: An EVENT item counts toward EVENT_EVIDENCE only when source_text_verified is true on both the source and the item. Until then its dates are listed in event_lead_dates_unverified and the row carries EVENT_LEAD_UNVERIFIED.
event_verification_rule.current_state: Every source in this file has source_text_verified=false, so no row carries EVENT_EVIDENCE.
how_to_promote: Reopen the source file itself (not a summary of it) and archive it reproducibly.

Set sources[id].source_text_verified=true and fill verification_record: archived_sha256 (64 hex), archive_locator (repo path or stable URL of the archived bytes), verified_on (YYYY-MM-DD), verified_by.
On each EVENT item confirmed in the archived bytes set source_text_verified=true and fill verification: locator (page, table, row) and verified_statement (the text as it appears).
Regenerate state_flags, suggested_state, verified_event_dates, event_lead_dates_unverified and summary; the validator rejects any mismatch.
event_verification_rule.never_eligible: Per-unit dates read from IGP IT 001-2023 (event_lead_eligible=false): main registers that report as territorial context whose transfer to a named local unit is forbidden. NGO, press and state-news items are IDENTITY leads and never EVENT items.

parent_basin_rule: parent_basin_or_system is null on every row: no source read in this audit states a parent hydrographic unit for a new candidate, and proximity, district or receiver names are not hydrographic assignments. Existing units keep whatever main already records.

priority_definitions.EXISTING: Already registered in main (local unit, candidate system or cited source). No incorporation needed; this audit only adds cross-references.
priority_definitions.P1: Carretera Central / Rímac / Santa Eulalia unit that is not a registered local unit in main and has an institutional event lead (unverified) and/or a regulatory geometry lead.
priority_definitions.P2: Either (a) a unit in Pisco/Ica, Santa/Casma or Tumbes/Zorritos with an institutional event lead (unverified) and/or a geometry lead, or (b) a Carretera Central name supported only by identity, works, NGO/press or unverified evidence, which needs a verified primary institutional source first.
priority_definitions.P3: Identity or critical-point evidence only, in a priority corridor or in a corridor already present in IRFEN (other Lima valleys and Lima Metropolitana, Piura coast, Lambayeque, La Libertad).
priority_definitions.P4: Interior/sierra rows outside the corridors currently present or planned in IRFEN; kept so the source tables stay complete.
